note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry, the column for Iraq, as the copy gives it. Its bank and branch positions are written 42461 and 42556, a spreadsheet's day numbers for 1 April and 5 July 2016; read as 1-4 and 5-7, as its IBAN structure and example (IQ98NBIQ850123456789012) show. A national check inside the BBAN, where the country has one, isn't in the registry and isn't modelled: a number drawn here passes the IBAN's own check. Release 103 (September 2026) is SWIFT's current; changes since this copy aren't read.
